L’intervention des cordistes est interdite et nécessite l’utilisation d’une nacelle automotrice pilotée par des personnels certifiés munis de moyens de protection individuelle normalisés. (Voir article “ Etablissement des Plans de prévention des risques”) La méthode de pose est la s

isée suivant les mesures de prévention indiqué au plan de prévention, à l’écart de la circulation du public. La pose de filets de protection n’est pas nécessaire. La circulation de la nacelle sur Piazza se fait par la voie de circulation dite « Pompier ». 2.2.2.3- - Dépose/Pose des bâches (B) de la BO.3a et BO.3b : Même caractéristique que la méthode de dépose /pose (article 2.2.2.1) Ces bâches sont fixées sur une structure existante composée de quatre câbles gainés fixés sur une structure métallique rigide. En l’état actuel, le module de stockage est positionné à proximité de la chenille. Il est nécessaire de formuler la demande de déplacement du module de lavage 8 jours ouvrables avant la date d’intervention, au responsable du marché. La bâche BO.3 se fixe depuis une nacelle de 60 m stationnée sur la Piazza Pompidou, dans une zone à baliser et à surveiller strictement. La pose d’un filet de protection ou replis de la bâche existante est indispensable sur la chenille en verre pour protection. La mise en place d’une signalétique de coupure et la pose de rubans pour la fermeture des escaliers mécaniques entre le N1 et N4 au début de l’opération pour prévention est également indispensable. 2.2.2.4- - Dépose/Pose des bâches (B) de la BE.1/2/3) : Ces bâches sont fixées sur une

Contract Ref: FM-DHSA-520963-NC-RFP

 

Dear Bidder,

 

  1. The FSM Department of Health & Social Affairs hereby invites you to submit a quotation for the following works:

 

Lot 1: Website Design & Development Services for the Yap Women Association Digital Village

 

Lot 2: Development of a User-Friendly Point of Sale (POS) System for Women-led Businesses in FSM

 

  1. The budget for this procurement is $40,000.00 (for both lots).

 

  1. To assist you in the preparation of your price quotation, we enclose the necessary Terms of Reference, Specifications, Priced Activity Schedule (AS), and Form of Contract.

 

  1. This RFQ invites you to quote for 1 lot or both lots. Quotations for each lot must be submitted separately, with the signed Form of Quotation (including the priced AS) electronically at the following address(s): takiko.ifamilik@hsa.gov.fm and msamo@fsmhealth.fm

 

  1. This invitation is issued under the open RFQ a

When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ents; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035-0001 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

The Contractor shall provide health insurance services under this contract to eligible employees at U.S. Embassy Lisbon and U.S. Consulate Ponta Delgada, Azores. TYPE OF CONTRACT 1. This is a fixed-price indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity (IDIQ) with economic price adjustment requirement under which annual firm-fixed price task orders will be issued. The fixed premium rates for the health insurance services as specified in Section C – Statement of Work provided herein are provided in Attachment 3 – Pricing Schedule. The quantities set forth in the pricing section are estimates; the Government does not guarantee that such quantities will be ordered. 2. The contract will be for a one base year period and four (4) one-year periods. In accordance with FAR 52.217-8, the contract may be extended by additional six (6) months period. Services shall commence no later than January 01, 2027. The Government is obligated only to the extent of authorized task orders actually made under this IDIQ. 3. Payments will be made only to the extent specifically authorized in the task order. Each task order will fund a specific period of time and number of covered individuals. ACQUISITION METHOD This is a commercial acquisition as defined in the Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) 2.101, Definitions, and as described in FAR part 12, Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services. Introduction The Administrative Office of the United States Courts (AO) is seeking contractor services for the printing and mailing of the following Internal Revenue Service (IRS) information returns: • W-2, Wage and Tax Statement USCA27R0019 /0001 - Page 4 of 14 • 1099-R, Distributions from Pensions, Annuities, Retirement or Profit-Sharing Plans, IRAs, Insurance Contracts, etc. • 1099-INT, Interest Income • 1099-MISC, Miscellaneous Income • 1099-C, Cancellation of Debt The printing and mailing support service will allow the Federal Judiciary to accomplish the requirement on the annual IRS tax reporting obligations. This contract will be for printing and mailing services ONLY and DOES NOT include the contractor providing any other tax-related services. The AO will provide ready-to-print and mail Portable Document File (PDF) data files to the contractor with all W-2 and 1099 boxes prepopulated with the appropriate tax information along with appropriate instructions of each tax form. The contractor shall provide the judiciary with electronic copies of all W-2s and 1099s printed and mailed to the recipients. The contractor must have the capability to securely receive and store electronic files from the AO using AO approved encryption methods such as Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP) for files in-transit and hard disk encryption for files at-rest.
